solutions.explanationMarkdown: Scan once. Start a new count whenever a value differs from its predecessor; otherwise extend the current run. The output contains exactly one count per maximal run.
solutions.complexityNotes: n is the number of values. Auxiliary space excludes the O(n) result.

solutions.source: let runWidths values = let rec loop prev width acc = function [] -> List.rev (if width=0 then acc else width::acc) | v::rest -> if prev=Some v then loop prev (width+1) acc rest else loop (Some v) 1 (if width=0 then acc else width::acc) rest in loop None 0 [] values
